overall: AG found the MOU Group was not a subcommittee but was a public body that violated the OML by meeting without posting notice, providing public access, or keeping minutes; ordered compliance and minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that the pairs of members each public body assigned to the MOU Group were subcommittees of their respective bodies subject to the OML.
allegations.key_passage: One body of six members was created, not three subcommittees of two members each.

allegations.summary: Whether the MOU Group, formed from members of three public bodies to finalize a property transfer, was itself a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law, including the Connelly exception argument.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the totality of the facts available to us, we find that the MOU Group was a public body.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the subcommittee members met outside of a posted public meeting, including the March 21 meeting with the Town Administrator.
allegations.key_passage: Where the MOU Group did not comply with the requirements of the Open Meeting Law relative to the March 21 meeting or any other meeting, including the requirements to post notice, provide public access or prepare minutes, it violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the subcommittee members failed to create minutes of their meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Where the MOU Group did not comply with the requirements of the Open Meeting Law relative to the March 21 meeting or any other meeting, including the requirements to post notice, provide public access or prepare minutes, it violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements, with a caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
Create and approve, within 60 days of receipt of the letter, minutes for the March 21, 2024 meeting and any other meetings the MOU Group has held, to the best of its ability.
Send a copy of the meeting minutes to the complainant within 65 days of receipt of the letter.
Make the minutes available to the public upon request.
If the MOU Group held other meetings, create accurate minutes of those meetings to the best of its ability.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Law’s requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
